title: Restore stats capture when Fastmail omits query filters
description: Daily GitHub stats capture has failed since 2026-10-27: FastmailAccount.getMailboxes assumes Email/query echoes filter.inMailbox. Live responses omit filter. Correlate queries using their JMAP invocation IDs and add regression coverage.

title: Keep PushNotification integration tests out of the offline suite
description: npm run test:airplane selects PushNotification.spec.ts because its Fastmail integration tests are missing the @online tag. Its beforeEach calls reset against FASTMAIL_API_TOKEN; the production-account safety guard currently prevents mutations. Ensure offline tests never contact Fastmail.

title: Finish the contact-group acceptance test steps
description: npm run test:acceptance fails Drag new email to Paperwork: the Given and When step implementations in features/step_definitions/steps.ts are commented out, so the expected add-to-group change never occurs. This predates the stats capture repair.
